rationale: The 3.2.0 Help matrix dates the release September 24 and lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 with Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. The September 8 upstream changelog gives Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. Both describe the scoped Queue secretKeyRef breaking change. The upgrade guidance advances the Operator before Enterprise. Preserve the two scopes and earlier corrected matrix-range history.

exclusions: No universal Kubernetes maximum, Enterprise 11.x compatibility, app pairing, Cloud availability or authorization is established.
